integrity: The analytic proof is complete for the stated mathematical model. Supplementary local arithmetic and optimization checks are finite experiments, not independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact mathematical result for an idealized wet-exponential-decay/dry-exponential-recovery Horton capacity model, saturated rainfall, a fully recovered initial state, four equal wet durations, freely allocable nonnegative dry gaps, and no switching overhead. Not a field-calibrated prediction; historical priority relative to inaccessible older pulse-irrigation literature is provisional.
title: A sharp dry-gap activation threshold for four equal Horton infiltration bursts
